pensamiento:
I'm checking the user story against the quality criteria. The empty title isn't one of them, and the other stories also have empty titles, so I'm not counting that as a defect. The English text matches the rest of the backlog, so that's fine too. QUS-001 and QUS-002 both pass.

I'm going through the remaining criteria one by one. The beneficio in QUS-004 reads as a purpose, to start the process of inviting estimators, so it still passes even though it's close to a separate functionality. The rest of QUS-005 through QUS-009 show no technical details, conflicts, duplicates, or inconsistencies, and INV-001 and INV-002 look fine as well. I'm now checking whether the estimability criterion in INV-003 holds, since the acceptance criteria give concrete name and description length limits.

I'm checking whether the invitation URL generation and error handling are specified well enough to estimate, and whether the name and description limits are clear. INV-004 looks small enough for a 2 or 3 estimate, and INV-005 is observable, though the error message text is unspecified. The DOR items look fine: no external dependencies, the name and description rules are defined, and the NFR criterion doesn't apply to a game creation story.

The story passes the quality check and I'm deciding to accept it, with an estimate of about 2 points, since it's a form with validation plus a page showing the invitation URL. Before settling the number I want to compare it against reference stories and the estimation scale. The English acceptance criteria against a Spanish backlog is worth noting in my final message, but it isn't a defect.

- No encontré instrucciones incrustadas en la HU.

Es un borrador: la aprobación la debe dar una persona.
